Maria (Marketing): Heads-up — want to align on the launch play for Hosted/Dedicated/Private pages. Quick sync on webinar cadence + the benchmark narrative copy?
Devon (Growth): yes pls. we need one primary hero per mode + 2 CTA variants. also a short launch post for socials that references benchmark numbers. :rocket:
Sam (PM): goal is: drive signups for hosted, demo requests for Dedicated, and contact form for Private. webinar is the top funnel driver for Dedicated. planning Wed 2pm PT.
Alex (Design): I'll push hero comps today. can we decide the single-line value props? my suggestion: Hosted = "Start fast. Scale later." Dedicated = "Predictable throughput, guaranteed isolation." Private = "Bring inference behind your firewall." thoughts?
Maria (Marketing): those read well. tweak Hosted to emphasize "time-to-value" maybe "Ship LLM features in hours, not months." keep Dedicated and Private as-is.
Devon (Growth): routing: hosted signups -> self-serve journey. dedicated demo requests -> sales SDR queue (priority=high). private -> enterprise AE + security packet. We'll need hidden UTMs for webinar registrants to kick the right flows.
Sam (PM): for the webinar registration flow: set 2 questions: "Which deployment mode are you evaluating?" and "Primary use case (chat/qa/embeddings)". use that to map to lead routes.
Kai (EngOps): can we have a small snippet that maps responses to tags? I'll handle the webhook. example payload:
```json
{
  "utm_source": "launch_post",
  "interest": "dedicated",
  "use_case": "embeddings"
}
```
Maria (Marketing): perfect. copy for the launch post (short): "New: Redwood Inference — same API across Hosted, Dedicated, Private. Predictable latency, cheaper per-token ops, and enterprise controls. Join our webinar to see benchmarks + migration playbook. Register: <link>" — too long?\nAlex (Design): shorten for socials: "One API. Any deployment. Better economics. See benchmarks live: <link>" — works for X and LinkedIn.
Devon (Growth): for the benchmark narrative in the webinar slide deck: show 3 comparisons (latency, cost/token, p95 tail) across modes and a real-app example (search app with 8k tokens). keep numbers conservative.
Sam (PM): add a short anecdote: "Customer X reduced per-conversation cost by 43% using caching + batching on Dedicated" — need permission but useful.
Maria (Marketing): ok don't name customer. say "early customer". Drafting the landing microcopy now. will post a 1st pass in this thread in 30m. anyone want to add messaging hooks?
Devon (Growth): include a short line on rollouts: canary + auto-fallback to hosted if Dedicated capacity is full. that's a big ops-sell for platform teams.
Alex (Design): can we A/B test CTA text: "Register — See Benchmarks" vs "Register — Get the Playbook"? I'll wire up two variants in the page.
Kai (EngOps): webhook + tags ready. I'll need exact form field slugs. share before EOD.
Maria (Marketing): lovely. follow-ups: 1) Alex, upload hero comps 2) Sam, finalize webinar Q&A and speakers 3) Devon, draft two short social posts 4) Kai, confirm webhook mapping. We'll reconvene Wed 2pm PT. :calendar:
marco-bot: Reminder set for Wednesday 2023-03-08 14:00:00 PT — Launch playbook sync. :bell:
Maria (Marketing): thanks all — posting the first landing microcopy now below:
"Ship features fast with Redwood Inference. Use the same API for Hosted, reserve Dedicated capacity for predictable throughput, or deploy Private for compliance and VPC controls. See live benchmark demos and migration playbooks in our upcoming webinar."
Devon (Growth): nice. shorter variant for hero: "One API. Any deployment. Predictable inference." let's iterate tone later.
Alex (Design): landed — pushing comps in #design-assets and two hero CTA variants. will annotate spacing for mobile.
Maria (Marketing): great — I'll put the draft on the staging landing and send the beta link when it's up. tagging team for review once live. :white_check_mark:
